import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}banks`;// Get banks
const getBanks=async()=>{const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL);return response.data;};// Delete bank
const deleteBank=async bankId=>{const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+'/'+bankId);return response.data;};const updateBank=async(bankId,bankData)=>{const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+'/'+bankId,bankData);return response.data;};// Create new bank
